checked_against: GitHub fetch_file pinned to candidate_head; optional full-checkout hash verification remains separate
abstraction_boundaries: The model deliberately covers five non-orthogonal dispatch profiles; PLATFORM_VALIDATOR and CLOSURE_VALIDATOR are not proved here.
TLC uses one Task, two possible Writers, and Boolean monotone stages; it omits retries, expirations, source drift, hidden validation, CI environment equivalence and external failures.
Source text-to-model semantic fidelity and exhaustive natural-language coverage are NOT_PROVEN.
The model is of a proposed candidate source and makes no prospective Freeze or release decision.
